dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, private banking. Rachel Tan speaking. How may I help you today?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hi, Marcus Lim here. Managed to get away from the depot floor for a while, so I thought better call you directly. My work phone keeps ringing today.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you for calling. May I take your identification details before we get into the discussion?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: My identification number is G one two oh two three six three W. My date of birth is the fourteenth of August nineteen fifty-five.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Is this a convenient place for you to speak privately? I can hear some activity in the background.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I'm in the office now, door closed already. Outside they're sorting out the delivery schedules. Got a bit of noise, but nobody else is here with me.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. We can keep the conversation focused. What would you like to discuss?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: The holding I want you to transact in is Harbor SGD Bond Fund. For this transaction, use Singapore dollars.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Your objective is to reduce your exposure to bond-market volatility and free up liquidity for flexibility in your business. With Harbor SGD Bond Fund, rising market interest rates can lower the value of the underlying bonds and therefore the fund's unit price. Do you understand how rising interest rates could reduce the value of your holding through that effect on the underlying bonds?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I understand. Rates go up, the bonds can fall in value, then my fund units can be worth less.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: You could lose some or all of the capital you invested, and selling may crystallise a loss. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including a loss crystallised by selling your holding?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm willing to accept investment losses, including taking a loss when I sell. I want to reduce the exposure lah.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I recommend reducing your holding in Harbor SGD Bond Fund to lower your exposure to interest-rate and credit-market fluctuations and release liquidity for your business if the sale executes.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: But can you guarantee my returns with this exit plan or not? I don't like not knowing how it'll turn out.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I cannot guarantee future returns or the outcome of the sale. A limit order controls the price you will accept, but it does not ensure execution.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: The amount for the transaction is 150,000. The quantity I want to transact is 2,000 units. I want to sell, not add to the holding.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: For any follow-up contact, would you prefer a telephone call or a message asking you to call us?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Call me directly lah. Messages sometimes disappear under all the work chats. If I'm out with the drivers, I might miss it, but I'll call back when I'm somewhere quiet.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can note that contact preference. Would you prefer us to avoid calling the office line?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, use my usual mobile for contacting me. Office line goes through the staff, then they have to come looking for me. Telephone easier; I can actually finish the conversation instead of typing halfway and getting distracted.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. I will note your preference for your usual mobile rather than the office line. Was there anything else you wanted to add?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Someone involved in an issuer's internal restructuring discussions told me confidentially that they're preparing an unannounced debt restructuring expected to impair the bonds this fund holds. That's why I'm instructing you to sell my holding before the news comes out. Make it a limit order at 75 Singapore dollars per unit.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you for speaking with me today. I will leave our conversation there. Goodbye.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks for your time. Bye.
